description: This C# source file defines the CommentsController class, which handles HTTP requests related to comments in an ASP.NET Core web application. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, and deleting comments associated with articles using MediatR for command and query dispatching.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling comment-related HTTP endpoints such as creating, listing, and deleting comments associated with articles.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new comment to an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve comments for an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific comment by ID from an article.
